title: G12: Alternates and side rooms in lesson.yaml (M)
description:
lesson.yaml can declare alternate paths and optional side rooms (also carries R7 challenges).
Acceptance:
- Given an alternate, the loader validates it and the player offers it after the goal.
- A side room is optional, skippable and does not block the next lesson.
- Progress records visits.

comments.text: Kept as low priority under RM W8 (SIE-8c5f31): needed only for the optional side room 'f in Rust' after c4/05 (guardian decision 7). Close if the side room is dropped.
